name: Extinguishing Touch (Ex)
body:
Prerequisite: None

Benefit: The alchemist can create a fine black powder from his hand that extinguishes fires and small light sources. This essentially allows him to cast snuff at will, but with a range of touch. Touching a small fire to extinguish it does not damage the alchemist.
